pages.text: $(thing)Apotheosis$(/thing) affixes are random modifiers that appear on weapons and armor dropped by mobs and bosses. $(thing)IridescentCraft$(/thing) adds $(bold)30 custom affix entries$(/bold) on top of Apotheosis's built-in pool.$(br2)Affixes also provide $(bold)gem sockets$(/bold). Higher-rarity affixed items have more sockets. $(l:icraft:loot/gems)See the Gems entry$(/l) for socket details.

pages.title: Affix Tiers
pages.text: $(bold)Common$(/bold) — Available $(t1)Tier 1$(end)+. Mild bonuses. 0–1 sockets.$(br)$(bold)Uncommon$(/bold) — Available $(t2)Tier 2$(end)+. Moderate bonuses. 1–2 sockets.$(br)$(bold)Rare$(/bold) — Available $(t2)Tier 2$(end)+. Strong bonuses. 2 sockets.$(br)$(bold)Epic$(/bold) — Available $(t3)Tier 3$(end)+. Very strong bonuses. 2–3 sockets.$(br)$(bold)Legendary$(/bold) — Available $(t4)Tier 4$(end). Exceptional bonuses. 3–4 sockets.$(br)$(bold)Mythic$(/bold) — Post-endgame Rift infusion only. Maximum bonuses. 4 sockets.

pages.title: Reforging
pages.text: $(thing)Apotheosis$(/thing)'s Reforging Station allows replacing an item's affixes with newly-rolled ones. $(thing)IridescentCraft$(/thing) adds three reforge token tiers that control the minimum affix quality:$(br2)$(bold)Basic Reforging Token$(/bold) — minimum Uncommon$(br)$(bold)Advanced Reforging Token$(/bold) — minimum Rare$(br)$(bold)Ultimate Reforging Token$(/bold) — minimum Epic$(br2)Tokens are crafted from boss materials. See $(l:icraft:loot/token_system)Tier Tokens$(/l) for recipes.

pages.title: Champion Affixes
pages.text: $(thing)Champions$(/thing) are elite mob variants (glowing) with special abilities. $(thing)IridescentCraft$(/thing) adds 5 custom Champion affixes beyond the built-in 16:$(br2)$(bold)Commanding$(/bold) — buffs nearby mobs$(br)$(bold)Draining$(/bold) — leeches your mana/XP on hit$(br)$(bold)Hexing$(/bold) — applies random debuffs$(br)$(bold)Leaping$(/bold) — closes distance instantly$(br)$(bold)Summoning$(/bold) — spawns reinforcements$(br2)Champions spawn at ~8% base rate and scale to higher rates in harder dimensions.
